name: fintech-banking-platform
description: Sandbox-first, ledger-first fiat and crypto banking platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fintech/web && npm run build --workspace @fintech/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @fintech/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @fintech/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @fintech/api && npm run test --workspace @fintech/web
scripts.verify: npm run secrets:check && npm run db:validate && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
